auftrag: Read the newspaper report. Then solve five puzzles.

saetze: Silver Compass found – double agent caught!
Yesterday evening, Agent Wren found the Silver Compass in a locker at the Blue Teapot café in Brighton.
It was wrapped in a green cloth, but Wren told only one trainee about the cloth.
Later, Mr Hale said in front of everybody that the thief had wrapped the compass in a green cloth.
Agent Wren asked the police to follow him.
At six o'clock Pidge the pigeon followed Mr Hale to a bridge, and there the police arrested him.
He had planned to sell the compass to a collector.

raetsel.frage: What is the best summary of the report?
optionen: Sam wrote a story about a green cloth.
The police lost the Silver Compass in Brighton.
Mr Hale stole the compass and was caught because of a detail only the thief knew.
raetsel.hilfe1: Read the whole report. What is the big news?
raetsel.hilfe2: Look at the sentence that begins: Nobody else could know that.

raetsel.frage: Tap the sentence that shows how Mr Hale gave himself away.
raetsel.hilfe1: Look for the word "cloth" in the second paragraph.
raetsel.hilfe2: It is the first sentence of the second paragraph.

raetsel.frage: True or false? “Mr Hale wanted to give the compass back to the Academy.”
raetsel.hilfe1: Read the last sentence of the report.
raetsel.hilfe2: He had planned to ... the compass.
raetsel.rtyp: True, false or not in the text

raetsel.frage: Put the events in the right order. What happened first?
items: Mr Hale talked about the green cloth.
Wren asked the police to follow him.
raetsel.hilfe1: Read the report from top to bottom.
raetsel.hilfe2: The arrest is the last event.

raetsel.frage: Put the words in the right order. It is a sentence from the report.
raetsel.hilfe1: The sentence starts with the time.
raetsel.hilfe2: After "Pidge" comes the word that tells you what Pidge did.
